claim.statement: Constraint Music implements a versioned, fail-closed generation and certification pipeline whose current-schema validation, request binding, declared rule outcomes, bounded oracle comparisons, corruption benchmark, scope-normalized comparator adapters, and recorded performance matrix are reproducible within their explicitly declared finite domains.
scope: the finite oracle, corruption, comparator, and performance domains recorded in the repository
the pinned dependencies and environment declarations attached to each evidence family

classification_definitions.satisfied: Implemented and linked to repository evidence that can be checked from a clean checkout.
classification_definitions.deferred_by_non_claim: Not required for the frozen claim because an explicit non-claim excludes it.
classification_definitions.blocker: Required for the frozen claim or EH-12 release process and not yet complete.

decision_policy.hold_when: At least one residual or EH-12 gate is classified as blocker.
decision_policy.complete_when: No blocker remains, every satisfied item names existing evidence, every deferral maps to an explicit non-claim, and the clean-checkout assurance gate passes without deviation.

non_claims.statement: Universal musical soundness, aesthetics, or unique tonal interpretation.
Global solver/compiler/checker equivalence outside the declared finite partitions.
Absolute implementation independence from every shared data type or serialization helper.
Population-level robustness inferred from the finite corruption corpus.
Comparative superiority, general external-tool equivalence, or state-of-the-art performance.
Capacity, latency-SLO, cross-platform, or production-performance guarantees.
Research novelty, venue acceptance, or publication readiness established by repository CI alone.
Beat- or transition-local diagnostics for every global validation failure.

residuals.title: Complete the schema adversarial matrix
acceptance_criteria: Every required current-schema field family has a valid control and at least one malformed type, shape, nullability, or length mutation.
Every supported legacy schema fixture is proven non-certifying at the strict boundary.
All cases retain stable expected outcomes and fail without an uncaught exception.

residuals.title: Expand solved cross-feature delivery controls
acceptance_criteria: Frozen valid controls exercise combined harmonic features through certified-satb delivery.
At least one control exercises melody-plus-satb with rhythm articulation.
Each control has exact parse-back event and output-digest evidence.

residuals.title: Add authenticated signing
residuals.rationale: SHA-256 binding is scoped to independently trusted inputs; the frozen claim does not assert authenticated origin.

residuals.title: Narrow every global diagnostic location
residuals.rationale: Typed outcomes, rule IDs, phase spans, and fail-closed visitation are in scope; universally minimal diagnostic locations are not.

residuals.title: Expand semantic-dispatch feature interactions
acceptance_criteria: The corpus includes valid and faulty controls for modulation with modal mixture, modulation with secondary harmony, and modal mixture with secondary harmony on disjoint beats.
Dispatch remains derived from reconstructed semantics rather than diagnostic text or trusted function labels.
Every targeted fault is rejected by its declared rule family.

residuals.title: Split all shared result types from mixed runtime modules
residuals.rationale: The checker-only dependency boundary is executable and tested; the frozen claim does not assert absolute codebase independence.

residuals.title: Grow the hand-adjudicated full-piece corpus
acceptance_criteria: Each consolidated interaction family has a frozen full-piece control and a targeted fault.
Expected outcomes are adjudicated independently of serialized generator labels.
Oracle implementation hashes and adjudication notes are recorded.

residuals.title: Broaden named compiler-clause deletion evidence
acceptance_criteria: At least two additional named compiler clauses from distinct registered phases are deleted one at a time.
Each deletion exposes a forced witness rejected by the independent oracle or verifier and by the production finalization boundary.
Constraint indices, phase spans, source hashes, and escape counts are persisted.

residuals.title: Add independently curated benchmark fixtures
acceptance_criteria: The consolidated corpus contains at least three frozen valid fixtures with distinct specifications and seeds, not only the original corruption fixture.
Controls and mutations preserve fixture identity, attack cluster, expected outcome, and raw issues.
Reported metrics retain exact denominators, controls, crashes, exclusions, and cluster boundaries.

residuals.title: Add more external tools and broader comparator domains
residuals.rationale: The frozen claim is limited to the two pinned music21 adapters and does not infer superiority or general equivalence.

residuals.title: Repeat performance evaluation on owned controlled hardware
residuals.rationale: The checked-in measurements remain finite observations from the recorded runner and solve budget, not an operational guarantee.

eh12_gates.title: Freeze claims and adjudicate every inherited residual
Produce the consolidated assurance corpus
acceptance_criteria: All PR-34 residual acceptance criteria are satisfied by one versioned corpus, raw result set, and derived summary.
The corpus is deterministic where workers=1 and preserves all failures, exclusions, and crashes.

eh12_gates.title: Add the one-command release-assurance validator
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout can validate pinned dependencies, tests, builds, checker isolation, evidence replay, and evidence SHA-256 values with one documented command.
CI executes the release-assurance validator and fails on evidence or claim drift.

eh12_gates.title: Enforce machine-verifiable clean-checkout assurance
acceptance_criteria: The release validator binds every run to a clean Git commit and tree, rejects dirty or mismatched checkout state, and verifies the GitHub Actions commit and workspace identity when present.

Ephemeral CI checkouts run the same fail-closed validator across every supported Python minor; any claim, evidence, environment, replay, build, isolation, or checkout deviation fails the gate and is retained in the workflow log.
There is no manual exception path: a deviation is disposed only by a versioned repository change followed by a successful complete rerun.
Research novelty and venue suitability remain a separate literature-backed research gate.
